Resolves #20345

Related: #20328

Deduplicates `.github/workflows/substrate-sync.yml` on pull requests (where `pr-baseline.yml`'s required `baseline / Skills materialized` already runs) so it triggers on `push: branches: [dev, main]` only, and consolidates the 12 fast repo-local `buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs` workflows (`guard-ci-parity-lint.yml`, `class-module-scope-lint.yml`, `content-root-derivation-lint.yml`, `engine-brain-boundary-lint.yml`, `fixed-sleep-lint.yml`, `jsdoc-type-lint.yml`, `check-relative-links.yml`, `theme-coverage-lint.yml`, `theme-value-file-lint.yml`, `check-examples-body-only.yml`, `check-theme-surfaces.yml`, `front-door-fingerprint.yml`) into a single `.github/workflows/guard-ci-parity-lint.yml` job (`jobs.lint`) that runs `checkout` + `setup-node` + `npm ci --ignore-scripts` once and executes all 12 guards sequentially in ~6s. Saves up to **12 runner slots** (13 -> 1 runner job) and 6 redundant `npm ci` installs per Engine PR.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite `check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs` + `ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs` + direct execution of all 12 consolidated guards + `check-workflow-concurrency.mjs`) → L2 required (all 4 close-target ACs are workflow trigger, consolidation, guard-parity/concurrency CLI, and unit spec assertions).

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: RA-1 has a trap. `check-guard-ci-parity.mjs` counts any step carrying an `if:` key as masked (`:369`), so adding `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}` alone would turn the parity lint red. The rule needs one narrow exception: `!cancelled()` can skip a step only on a cancelled run, and a cancelled run never reads green, so it cannot produce the false green the lint exists to catch. Any other condition stays masked.

  The new arm also pins `mirrors.length` to 9. The next mirrored guard will fail that count for a reason unrelated to the invariant the `every(...)` line already carries (non-blocking).
